comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: For us on Maris server we do not have the recipes making the Improved/Modified hulls listed, only the first 3 for the regular hulls are available...

comments.author: V_I
comments.body:
I sent a support ticket to PapayaPlay asking if the recipes not being there was a bug, or intentional. This was their response:

"For our Uncharted Water Online, we're afraid the function where you can craft hulls using ship ornaments is disabled due to the developers' request. We hope you understand our situation. However, we may put some of them in the Treasure Cove in the future."
